facts.text: Downtown: The transit delays have eased up this week after running behind for months. A health fair at the church draws a steady crowd, while the SpeedyBurger line stays long at lunch.
Temescal: The new health center on Telegraph has its doors open, with a few people coming and going. At night, the OakTown Social patio fills up with regulars.
Laurel: A quiet week — nothing much out of the ordinary around the neighborhood.
West Oakland: Neighbors stop by the food pantry with reusable bags, while flyers for the block party still hang in some windows. The tenant defense office has a steady trickle of visitors.
Fruitvale: Architectural renderings for the transit hub expansion are pinned up in a storefront window. The usual crowd mills around the station between trains.
Jack London: The oyster bar has its patio heaters on early for evening diners. Moving trucks idle outside a couple buildings on the side streets.
Rockridge: A quiet vigil wraps up at the temple as the weekend market vendors start packing up their produce. The neighborhood feels calm.
Adams Point: The Methodist church has posted a sign about emergency aid availability. The lake path stays busy with joggers and dog walkers.
Grand Lake: The theater marquee changes over to a new show as sidewalk tables fill up for early dinners. More "now leasing" signs appear in windows.
Piedmont Ave: New faces carry moving boxes into a couple buildings. The medical offices see their usual steady stream of appointments.
Chinatown: The cultural center has its lights on late for an event. Grocery shoppers move between markets with full bags.
Brooklyn: A quiet week — nothing much out of the ordinary around the neighborhood.
Eastlake: Regulars chat with the barber between haircuts. The diner does its usual brisk breakfast business.
Glenview: A quiet week — nothing much out of the ordinary around the neighborhood.
Dimond: Neighbors gather at the community center for the emergency meeting. The strip feels quieter than usual afterward.
Ivy Hill: A "space for lease" sign goes up at the dental office. People walk dogs past empty storefronts.
San Antonio: A quiet week — nothing much out of the ordinary around the neighborhood.
KONO: A quiet week — nothing much out of the ordinary around the neighborhood.
Lake Merritt: A small wedding party takes photos by the lake. Moving vans unload at one of the older apartment buildings.
Uptown: The outdoor gallery installation draws sidewalk admirers. Restaurant patios stay full well into the evening.
Baylight District: Oakland Casino Town lost 3 employees.
East Oakland: A grief support gathering forms at the mosque. A moving truck unloads furniture at a bungalow.
